PROMISSORY NOTE

$750,000                                                          Columbus, Ohio
                                                                  June 15, 2026

FOR VALUE RECEIVED, Vanterra Mechanical Services, LLC, an Ohio limited liability company ("Maker"), promises to pay to the order of Buckeye Fifth Bank, N.A. ("Payee"), at 4400 Broad Street, Columbus, Ohio, or at such other place as Payee designates in writing, the principal sum of Seven Hundred Fifty Thousand Dollars ($750,000), together with interest as provided below.

1. Interest.

Interest accrues on the outstanding principal balance at a fixed rate of seven and one-half percent (7.5%) per annum, computed on the basis of a 360-day year and the actual number of days elapsed.

2. Payments.

Maker shall pay sixty (60) consecutive monthly installments of principal and interest of $15,022.41 each, commencing July 15, 2026 and continuing on the fifteenth day of each month thereafter, with the entire unpaid balance of principal and accrued interest due and payable on June 15, 2031 (the "Maturity Date").

3. Application.

Each payment is applied first to accrued and unpaid interest, then to principal, and any prepayment is applied to the installments in inverse order of maturity.

4. Prepayment.

Maker may prepay this Note in whole or in part at any time without premium or penalty.

5. Late Charge.

If any installment is not paid within ten (10) days after its due date, Maker shall pay a late charge equal to five percent (5%) of the overdue installment, and interest on the overdue amount shall accrue at the Default Rate.

6. Default Rate.

On and after an Event of Default, the unpaid principal balance bears interest at the lesser of twelve and one-half percent (12.5%) per annum and the maximum rate permitted by applicable law.

7. Events of Default.

Each of the following is an Event of Default: (a) failure to pay any amount when due and not cured within ten (10) days after written notice; (b) breach of any covenant in the Loan Agreement of even date and not cured within thirty (30) days after written notice; (c) Maker's assignment for the benefit of creditors; or (d) commencement of a bankruptcy proceeding by or against Maker that is not dismissed within sixty (60) days.

8. Acceleration.

Upon an Event of Default, Payee may declare the entire unpaid principal balance and accrued interest immediately due and payable without further notice, presentment, or demand, all of which Maker waives.

9. Costs of Collection.

Maker shall pay all reasonable costs of collection, including attorneys' fees, whether or not suit is filed.

10. Security.

This Note is secured by the Security Agreement of even date, and is subject to the terms of the Loan Agreement of even date.

11. Usury Savings.

Nothing in this Note requires the payment of interest in excess of the maximum rate permitted by applicable law. If any amount is construed as interest and would exceed that maximum, it shall be reduced to the maximum, and any excess already collected shall be applied to principal or refunded to Maker.

12. Waivers.

Maker and all endorsers waive presentment, demand for payment, protest, and notice of dishonor, and consent to any extension of time or release of collateral without notice.

13. Governing Law.

This Note is governed by the laws of the State of Ohio.

MAKER:

VANTERRA MECHANICAL SERVICES, LLC
